description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of fields in the trash. The list may be restricted to fields whose field name or description partially match a string.

Only custom fields can be queried, `type` must be set to `custom`.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with field names or descriptions.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description:
[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:

 *  `name` sorts by the field name
 *  `trashDate` sorts by the date the field was moved to the trash
 *  `plannedDeletionDate` sorts by the planned deletion date
parameters.name: orderBy
